text:
Aisha: Quick two-part poll — pick a sticker design + a codename for the next internal model. Vote by replying with e.g. "A + Lark". Closing in ~2h (or when the coffee runs out). Options:

Stickers:
A) Friendly fox — https://img.example.com/fox.png :fox_face:
B) Retro robot — https://img.example.com/robot.png :robot_face:
C) Summit patch — https://img.example.com/mountain.png :mountain:

Codenames:
1) Lark
2) Pioneer
3) Nebula

Cast your votes! @here

Tom: B + Lark. robot sticker is sending me. :robot_face: Also vote for Lark coz it sounds jaunty.

Marcel: A + Nebula. fox pls, fox is the office energy. :fox_face:

Priya: C + Pioneer. I like the patch for laptop corners. Pioneer for the model name.

Lara: quick q — are these full-size stickers or laptop-skin sized?

Aisha: Aisha: Mostly laptop-friendly (3x3). If there's demand we can do a sheet.

DevBot: DevBot: Poll recorded — B:1, A:1, C:1. Codenames Lark:1, Nebula:1, Pioneer:1. Tie-breaker suggestion: coinflip or All-Hands reveal. :coin:

Tom: coinflip sounds dramatic. I volunteer to flip and stream it on Friday. :raised_hands: 

Aisha: Aisha: Nice — Friday coinflip it is. Thanks everyone! Stickers will be ordered next week based on the flip.
